plain_explanation: Integrated Settlement: use official annual component table; C38 does not substitute one headline total for constituent funds.
2023–26 Culture Investment budget £4.425m/year. 2026–29: revised Spirit/Sustain; Inspire/Strategic continue; new sustainability pillar; sector-led body approved in principle.
Application/assessment produces a proposed package; recommended core-funded organisations return to GMCA for approval through budget process. 26 Sep 2025 approach decision was not subject to call-in.

Cllr Neil Emmott: Portfolio Lead for Culture; Alison McKenzie-Folan: Portfolio Lead Chief Executive for Culture; Marie-Claire Daly named GMCA contact officer. Proposed sector-led body's membership/appointment rules not yet evidenced.

Observed: named portfolio lead, lead chief executive, culture officer, Culture and Social Impact Fund Committee, multi-year Culture Fund, impact reporting. Not evidenced: culture-team FTE or administration cost.

Identifiable DCMS stream: Creative Places Growth Fund — 2026/27 £4.915m revenue + £3.333333m capital; 2027/28 £4.966667m + £3.333333m; 2028/29 £4.941667m + £3.333333m.
Each programme needs its own decision/delegation record. C38 does not claim the Mayor personally allocates the whole settlement or Creative Places Growth Fund.

Official provisional totals: £468.260868m; £512.895452m; £600.027772m; £529.608258m for 2026/27–2029/30. Government table lists each fund/home department; TBC remains unresolved.

Complete culture/heritage/sport officer hierarchy and cultural assessment-panel membership not yet verified.
Observed: CA Board, dedicated scrutiny, culture/framework work, Integrated Settlement, named investment programmes. Not evidenced: culture-team FTE and culture administration cost.

£2.95m allocation and Business Justification Case approved; implementation delegated to Director of Economy (Policy and Integration), consulting Legal, Procurement and Finance, without material change to scope/objectives/budget.
Programme record identifies Director of Economy (Policy and Integration) as delegated implementation authority. Complete culture-team hierarchy not inferred from one programme.
